chapter: Childhood, family and the sounds of New Orleans
title: Lakefront camps and Sunday picnic music
summary: Camps on stilts at Milenburg, West End and Seabrook hosted Sunday music.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You'd go on the riverfront, where I'm going to take you this week, and you'd see the camps on the riverfront, on the stilts, like you see in an Oriental country. There were camps out there. It was just loaded with camps, and every camp on a Sunday had some kind of a music. And they went out to play out on a picnic; they'd have a picnic at such-and-such a camp, at Little Woods or Milenburg or West Bend or Seabrook, all along there -- each two or three miles there was a little village. And there was music, and you'd see guys with their horns.
